main.execution_scope: Main c5 customer_results.py file loaded by importlib into the candidate package; transitive gridlens dependencies resolve from the candidate source tree. This is a main-file control, not a full main checkout execution.

candidate.execution_scope: Candidate customer_results.py and candidate package dependencies.

route_contract.main_legacy: Main-file control: c5 customer_results.groups default policy; candidate package dependencies.
route_contract.candidate_legacy: candidate groups(canonical_only=False), matched explicit legacy path
route_contract.round_order: main/candidate legacy pair alternates first position; candidate default alternates before/after pair

timing_definitions.total_ms: Wall time around direct groups() call; includes all SQL and deterministic projection.
timing_definitions.sql_execute_ms: Summed DBAPI cursor execute/fetch-call time for SQL issued during groups().
timing_definitions.payload_bytes: Compact JSON byte count of the returned response body.
timing_definitions.payload_sha256: SHA-256 of returned compact JSON body; raw body omitted.

limitations: One local synthetic 40k fixture, one database clone, and one execution environment.
selected_generation pins one already-published synthetic snapshot to compare query implementations; it bypasses the live current-generation qualification lookup.
This is a diagnostic comparison, not a service-level objective or production latency claim.
Historical account_total samples are null because the runner read totals.account_total rather than totals.accounts; those nulls are invalid account-count evidence and were not backfilled.
